steps.npc: Come now Effendi, to pass you must tell me a story, one of grand heroics!

steps.text: If the player has not completed Dragon Slayer:
You tell the tale of how you bested a goblin, it lacks heroics and sounds more like senseless murder.

steps.player: ...And then I pulled the goblin mail from the corpse, but it didn't fit, so I dropped it.

steps.npc: You thought that was a story of heroics?! Come back when you have something worth telling.

steps.text: To gain entrance to the resource area, you must first complete the quest 'Dragon Slayer'.
If the player has completed Dragon Slayer but have not spoken to Haris yet:
You tell the tale of how you bested the legendary dragon Elvarg in combat.

steps.player: ...And then I cut her head off, so as to make sure she was dead!

steps.npc: Amazing! A story well worth telling! Please Effendi, enter at your leisure.

steps.text: If the player has already obtained permission to enter area:

steps.npc: Of course Effendi! You have proved yourself worthy!
Me? I am Haris! Owner of the area north of here, it is has great resources, I assure you.

steps.player: You own the land? Who did you buy it from?

steps.npc: Buy? Oh no no no. Do you see this sword, Effendi?
Well then, that is why it is mine! Hahaha.

steps.player: Oh, so do I pay a toll? 10 coins should do, right?

steps.npc: Not quite, while gold can get you to many places, I seek stories of heroics, for my land is only for the worthy.

steps.player: Is the story behind your sword one of heroics?

steps.npc: I promise you, the monkey I took it from was big! Hahaha!

if-the-player-tries-to-enter-the-corsair.npc: Hey! I didn't say you could go in there!
